failures.name: Line Formation - 2 Drones 1
failures.instruction: Drones Drone 3 and Drone 5 form a line formation: both take off to 17 meters. Drone 3 positions at (454, 416, 17) and Drone 5 flys to (545, 609, 17) first, and then move to 19 meters at most to Drone 3. Both maintain formation for monitoring.

failures.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones) 1
failures.instruction: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 5, Drone 4, and Drone 3 take off together to 18 meters altitude. Drone 5 flies to target Fixed Target 1, Drone 4 flies to target Fixed Target 3, and Drone 3 flies to target Fixed Target 2. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 65m, then south for 55m, then north for 71m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 65m, south 55m, north 71m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

failures.name: Extreme Flight Marathon Navigation
failures.instruction: Drone 3 performs an extreme marathon flight. Take off to 27 meters, fly to start point (118, 72, 27), then zigzag across the full map through 20 intermediate waypoints: (99, 195, 27), (924, 165, 27), (200, 260, 27), (797, 286, 27), (127, 388, 27), (933, 496, 27), (237, 554, 27), (815, 650, 27), (105, 710, 27), (940, 761, 27), (233, 894, 27), (792, 932, 27), (496, 835, 27), (938, 543, 27), (55, 623, 27), (910, 380, 27), (107, 315, 27), (821, 80, 27), (312, 948, 27), (642, 537, 27). Avoid obstacles Polygon Obstacle 1, Polygon Obstacle 4, and Circle Obstacle 2. Finally, fly to end point (889, 910, 27) and land.
